definition: Planning text describes the assistant's current tool work or preparation of the answer. A leading readiness preamble qualifies when it introduces an answer, introduces source evidence, or explicitly confirms completed preparation. A source transition follows the same rule as an answer transition.
sampleMethod: The first 20 candidates in SHA-256 order of file, row index, and answer hash.
limits: The author reviewed a fresh deterministic sample after the independent review. No independent reviewer checked these revised labels.
The original screen matched 28 of 38 first-line cue answers. The revised screen matches 32 of 38.
Six first-line cue answers remain unmatched. A cue can introduce a legitimate evidence summary.
The first-line cue gap does not measure recall. This sample does not measure production prevalence.
The historical 155/500 broad screen used a different answer set and rule.
The sample contains answer preparation preambles. It contains no tool action match.
